decisions.briefing: Markets were modestly risk-on today (NASDAQ +1.0%, S&P 500 +0.5%). With 3 open slots and cash above the $500 threshold, deployed into three diversified momentum names (software, materials, financials) at medium conviction since none showed the full four-signal confirmation (missing volume surge). market_education.summary_en: Broad markets edged higher today with the NASDAQ outperforming the S&P 500, suggesting continued but moderate risk appetite among investors. Technology and growth names generally led the modest advance. No major headline catalysts were provided for today's session, so the move appears driven by steady underlying momentum rather than a specific news event.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤溫和上揚,納斯達克指數表現優於標普500指數,顯示投資人風險偏好持續但幅度溫和。科技與成長股普遍帶動小幅上漲。今日並無提供重大新聞觸發因素,顯示這波走勢較可能是延續既有動能所致,而非受單一消息面影響。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Before buying a stock on momentum, it's safer to check multiple technical signals together — like RSI being in a healthy bullish range, MACD showing a bullish crossover, and price trading above its 20-day moving average — rather than relying on just one indicator. When all signals line up, including a volume surge, conviction can be high; when only some align, it's wiser to size the position more conservatively.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 在依動能買入股票前,同時檢視多項技術指標會比只看單一指標更為穩健,例如RSI處於健康的多頭區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價站上20日均線等。當所有訊號(包含成交量放大)都一致時,可以提高信心;若只有部分訊號吻合,則應採取較保守的部位規模。
